description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company building multimodal agents across voice, SMS, and email. As a Founding Engineer, you will own a core product or engineering domain end to end, work directly with customers, and help shape technical and product decisions.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a domain from architecture through daily production releases.

 - Join customer calls, synthesize feedback, and make product decisions independently.

 - Build and optimize multimodal agents, including low-latency voice experiences and persistent conversations across channels.

 - Set quality practices for non-deterministic systems, including evaluations, prompt versioning, guardrails, and drift detection.

 - Build across React and Next.js frontends, Node.js backends, and Python services.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Three to eight years of full-stack engineering experience, with a record of shipping and scaling products in fast-paced environments.

 - Production proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, plus experience building Python services.

 - Hands-on experience building production systems with LLM APIs or agent SDKs.

 - Depth in at least one area: production voice or SMS agents, long-running agent state and memory, agent evaluations and guardrails, or B2B2C and marketplace architecture.

 - Ability to own product decisions, conduct customer discovery, and deliver independently in an early-stage environment.

 - Experience with low-latency systems and production AI or agentic systems. Voice pipelines, evaluation tooling, and infrastructure tools such as Redis or BullMQ are useful.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals or demonstrated founder experience and product traction.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site five days per week in New York, New York.
